Unfortunately, relentless rain led to the abandonment of the match. The series concluded with both teams even at 2-2 after five thrilling encounters, with India's swift scoring and the record-setting fifty marking a high point in the series finale.

description: In a heartbreaking incident at a Durga Puja pandal in north Kolkata, a stampede claimed the lives of at least 19 people and left 25 others injured amid a surge of visitors driven by panic from heavy rains. Rescue efforts were promptly initiated, and medical staff rushed the injured to hospitals.

author: LAIRENLAKPAM WARLI
description: A tragic stampede occurred at the Chorbagan Durga Puja pandal in north Kolkata on Saturday evening. This incident was triggered by a sudden crowd surge as rain fell, causing panic among waiting devotees. Eyewitnesses reported numerous people losing consciousness and being carried away for medical assistance. Authorities, including police and disaster management teams, have been deployed to assist the injured.

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: A chaotic stampede unfolded at the Sarada Park Durga Puja pandal in north Kolkata due to a crowd surge, leading to at least 1 deaths and 15 injuries. Emergency services transported the injured to Calcutta Medical College and Hospital for immediate medical assistance. The West Bengal health minister, alongside other political leaders, responded by visiting the scene and the hospital.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Ariana Grande maintains a tradition of sending Christmas gifts to children in hospitals across Greater Manchester. Her donations reached four hospitals, including Royal Manchester Children’s Hospital and North Manchester General Hospital. Grande began this charitable connection following the tragic Manchester Arena attack in 2017, which claimed 22 lives. Over the years, her repeated contributions have comforted young patients during difficult festive seasons.
title: Ariana Grande sent Christmas gifts to children at four Manchester hospitals

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Researchers utilized drone technology to discover three previously unregistered Aboriginal rock shelters in the Blue Mountains region, revealing significant cultural heritage. Collaboration with the Dharug Custodian Aboriginal Corporation ensured accurate documentation of red hand stencils and stone artifacts. This innovative approach may improve archaeological surveys in difficult-to-navigate areas, thereby preserving cultural heritage. Ongoing efforts will assess the method's applicability to different Australian landscapes, ensuring continued protection.
title: Drone LiDAR finds 3 unregistered Aboriginal rock shelters in Australian bushland

description: The incident occurred around 7.40 pm in the Girish Park police station area amid heavy crowds of pandal visitors and rainfall. As rain began, people waiting outside the pandal rushed forward, causing some to fall on the road and triggering a stampede, a senior police officer told PTI. All the injured were rescued and taken to Calcutta Medical College for treatment.

This portal allows victims to confidentially submit their complaints regarding violence that occurred in July. The Ministry of Home Affairs stated that submissions can also be made in person or via post. The committee will prioritize cases involving serious violence, especially against women protesters.

Captain Shreyas Iyer has included Bhuvneshwar along with Shivam Dube in the playing XI. West Indies leader Shai Hope opted for a bowling-first strategy, hoping to leverage it to his team's advantage.

author: LAIRENLAKPAM WARLI
description: Ashish Kumar allegedly strangled his sister Komal to death after discovering a young man in her room. This incident occurred on October 16 at their home in Lakhanor village. Following a complaint made by the victim's uncle, police arrested Kumar on the same day. During interrogation, Kumar admitted to killing Komal during an argument over the situation. He was later produced in court after completing all necessary legal procedures.

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: A tragic incident unfolded in Chassad village, Manipur, where a militant attack led to the death of one man and injuries to four others. Gunfire erupted between the militants and a local armed faction, with the violence persisting into the evening. Emergency services promptly transported the injured to a hospital, but sadly, one victim did not survive.
title: Man killed, four injured in suspected militant attack on Kuki village in Manipur

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: The man in this case failed to file his income tax return, and the Income Tax Department issued him a notice. He subsequently responded by filing an ITR for assessment year (AY) 2018-19, reporting an income of Rs 12.9 lakh. However, the Income Tax Assessing Officer (AO) took the view that this income would have remained outside the tax net had the department not issued the notice to the man.
title: Man skipped ITR, declared Rs 12.9 lakh income after notice; ITAT cancels 200% penalty

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Tiger Woods allows his children to pursue their own interests and dreams. But has also left the door open for them to play golf. Sam has been at Stanford University, while Charlie has taken up competitive golf and signed with Florida State University, and their divergent paths underscore the lasting legacy of the Woods family beyond Tiger’s legendary career.
title: Tiger Woods’ children Sam and Charlie: How are they shaping his golf legacy?

description: Richa Parasar has alleged mistreatment, threats and use of criminal force against her while she was reporting on a protest near the Supreme Court on October 12, 2026. Parashar, who said she was three months pregnant, has alleged that Rahul Gandhi 'grabbed her hand' and 'pulled her' forward before his security personnel pushed her away while she was covering the INDIA bloc's protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar on October 12.

description: Anant Singh is no ordinary legislator as locals rarely use his given name. They call him 'Chhote Sarkar', or little lord, because in the Barh and Mokama belt his word has often counted for more than the government’s. His story begins with his elder brother, Dilip Singh, who won as an independent and became a minister in Lalu Prasad’s cabinet during its first term, from 1990 to 1995.

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: In a shocking incident on September 30, Indian Captain Smit Machchhar endured an assault by his Omani co-pilot aboard flydubai flight FZ1073 en route from Dubai to Tel Aviv. With injury and determination, Machchhar opened the cockpit door, allowing passengers to step in and restrain the assailant. The aircraft landed safely in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, following a critical altitude drop.
title: 'Can't die like this': Indian pilot Smit Machchhar recalls flydubai flight ordeal

author: SWATI DESHPANDE
description: Imran Khan Pal filed a petition against a notice mandating his departure from India by October 28. He claims the notice violates his fundamental rights under the Indian Constitution and lacks justification. Khan argues that he has lived in India since he was two years old and is an Overseas Citizen of India. The notice was issued following his attendance at a protest, leading to claims of arbitrary detention.

description: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann's trip to Paris has triggered criticism from opposition leaders and parties. Concerns have been raised regarding drug abuse, law and order, and recent violent incidents in the state. Critics question the appropriateness of Mann's foreign visit, especially as he celebrated his birthday during a crisis. Allegations suggest that he attended a police meeting under the influence of alcohol, which raises further concerns.

author: NITESH DUBEY
description: The recent decision by India to omit Kuldeep Yadav from the T20I squad has ignited discussions among cricket analysts. Experts like Michael Clarke emphasize that Kuldeep's knack for claiming wickets is invaluable in T20 matches. Meanwhile, Naman Dhir has adequately taken on the role of the second spinner. Nevertheless, Kuldeep's past performances against the West Indies, along with his extensive experience, raise important questions about India's future selection policies.

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: Abhijeet Dipke was granted bail on certain conditions on Saturday, less than 24 hours after Delhi Police took him into preventive custody over his planned 'Tiranga Yatra' in Connaught Place (CP). Dipke was detained shortly after leaving the residence of NCP-SCP spokesperson Anish Gawande, where he had been staying, to attend the planned flag march in Connaught Place.

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: Military discussions are considering the use of the MOAB against Iran's nuclear facilities and military targets. However, the effectiveness of the MOAB is limited against deeply buried sites protected by reinforced concrete. Analysts highlight that the GBU-57 penetrator is better suited for such underground facilities, which require specialized weapons for effective targeting. While the MOAB has a strong psychological impact, its military utility against hardened targets is questionable.

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Kylie Kelce publicly praised Brittany Mahomes for her role in promoting women's soccer in Kansas City. Brittany is a co-owner of the Kansas City Current, contributing to the growth of women's sports. Her athletic background includes playing college soccer and founding Brittany Lynne Fitness. The establishment of CPKC Stadium highlights the investment in women's soccer in the area. Brittany's work emphasizes her individual identity beyond being an NFL player's wife.
title: Brittany Mahomes has two words for Kylie Kelce after her heartfelt praise

author: SANDEEP RAGHAVAN
description: Violent confrontations broke out between TDP and YSRCP activists in Kadapa during the nominations filing phase. Police had to intervene in Pulivendula when YSRCP supporters tried to rush the nominations centre. Clashes also occurred in places like Mydukur and Rayachoti, resulting in injuries among party workers. Several YSRCP leaders were placed under house arrest due to these escalating tensions.

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: USCIS warns immigrants and visa applicants about fraudulent schemes that promise quicker visa approvals in exchange for monetary fees. These scams frequently involve false claims of having special ties to government officials. USCIS insists that no one can hasten the immigration process through personal connections. Individuals should file applications independently and trust assistance only from recognized professionals. Recognizing fraudulent emails and suspicious offers is essential to protect against these scams.
title: USCIS: Anyone who ‘guarantees’ a faster visa or Green Card is scamming you

author: RAJIV SAXENA
description: In a heartbreaking incident early Saturday, a mini bus carrying 23 family members plunged into a drain en route to Khatu Shyamji temple from Bhopal. Rescue attempts were hampered by muddy conditions and water inside the drain. As of now, eight bodies have been recovered, and the injured are being promptly cared for at local hospitals. Authorities continue to work tirelessly to understand the full impact of this tragedy.
title: 8 killed as bus falls into drain on Delhi-Mumbai Expressway near Kota

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Brazil's Amazon rainforest has achieved a remarkable milestone, showing its lowest annual deforestation at just 3,335 square kilometres, dropping by 41.8 percent from last year's figure of 5,731 square kilometres. President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's ambitious goal to halt illegal logging by 2030 underscores a strong political commitment to preserve this vital ecosystem, which plays a crucial role in climate stability and global environmental health.
title: Brazil's Amazon deforestation hits record low: Why it matters amid election battle

author: ANJALI SINGH
description: A tragic explosion at a chemical plant in Bharuch, Gujarat, led to the loss of five workers' lives, with an additional five others injured and receiving hospital care. The incident disrupted ongoing manufacturing activities, creating a terrifying noise that sent shockwaves through the local community. As authorities delve deeper into the investigation, they aim to uncover the explosion's cause and implement measures to avert similar occurrences in the future.
title: 5 workers killed in explosion at chemical unit in Gujarat's Bharuch

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: The Defence Research and Development Organisation is working on compact electronic intelligence systems to analyze enemy signals. This initiative involves building portable modules that capture and study radar emissions effectively. As these systems identify and categorize signal characteristics, they enhance counter-drone tactics for field formations. The project includes development, integration, and qualification phases for ensuring operational readiness. Ultimately, the system will improve situational awareness in challenging terrains and environments.

Kaur may face deportation back to India if released early under a government initiative. This case highlights concerns over religious symbols linked to violence. Appeals from both Kaur and Digwa are set to be heard in November.

His unique musical style particularly enriched many Rajinikanth films, leaving an indelible mark with iconic introductory songs. An influential force in popularizing Gaana music during the 1990s, he contributed to more than 400 films in various Indian languages. His legacy is deeply mourned within the film community.

description: Mumbai Indians and head coach Mahela Jayawardene have mutually decided to part ways before the upcoming IPL season. The team management aims to bring in a new head coach for fresh perspectives. Candidates for the position are being interviewed with a decision expected soon. After a disappointing season, the franchise aims to improve performance going into the new cycle.

description: BMC has rejected the owners' response regarding the ongoing construction at the Juhu bungalow owned by Ajay Devgn. A stop-work notice was issued on September 10 due to unauthorized additions using Siporex blocks. As no authorization documents were submitted, the ongoing construction has been deemed unauthorized.

Further, he recommended reforms to the World Bank's lending framework to enhance development effectiveness.

Axar Patel is brought in to replace Jadeja, and both Shreyas Iyer and Ishan Kishan are welcomed back into the mix.

description: Tragedy struck Nagla Shri Padam village as five family members were found dead in their home on Saturday morning. Initial police investigations suggest food poisoning may be the culprit, but further confirmation is awaited. The victims include Mahesh, 37, Lalita, 35, and their three children aged three to eleven. Emergency responders and forensic teams are actively probing the incident, with bodies sent for postmortem examinations as part of standard procedures.

description: In February, two RAF jets experienced alarming encounters with unidentified objects over the North Sea. The first incident involved an object dangerously close to an RAF Voyager tanker during refueling. Shortly after, a Typhoon pilot reported seeing a circular object during training near Humberside. Notably, both entities were flying at altitudes beyond typical civilian drones but eluded radar detection. These occurrences raise alarm about potential Russian drone surveillance in Europe.

description: Manpreet Singh has revolutionized his five-acre farm in Punjab by implementing diverse agricultural methods. He cultivates onion seedlings and has developed a thriving nursery business that caters to around 250 customers. By strategically selecting crops and optimizing planting schedules throughout the year, Singh has created multiple income streams, including dairy and vegetable farming. Looking ahead, he aims to enhance his revenue further by incorporating modern farming technologies.

description: Steve Jobs returned to Apple in 1997 after being fired in 1985, prioritizing the brand's reinvention. description: India's Zorawar light tank program is facing a critical design challenge in upgrading protection without sacrificing mobility. The Indian Army requires stronger armour to resist more powerful ammunition and threats. Development is ongoing by the Defence Research and Development Organisation and Larsen & Toubro, with an expected service entry around 2028-2029. A phased approach might help balance initial production with future upgrades for protection.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Starting in January 2027, New York City's iconic Plaza Hotel will embark on a significant facade restoration that is projected to last a minimum of four years. This closure will impact not only guests but also local residents. With previous renovations totaling $450 million between 2005 and 2008, and a pandemic-related shutdown in 2020, this restoration seeks to uphold the hotel's renowned architectural significance for generations to come.

The team worked tirelessly on intricate tasks without rigid deadlines, fostering a spirit of collaboration and intellectual prowess.

description: In Mumbai, a debate has sparked over what to name the new East-West Vidyavihar bridge. Shiv Sena (UBT) is pushing for a tribute to the beloved late actor Nana Patekar, while BJP MLA Parag Shah champions Captain Smit Machchhar’s name. Advocates for Patekar highlight the importance of commemorating his legacy. Conversely, municipal officials question whether the bridge is the right venue for such recognition.

description: An IT professional, Mohammad Aslam, and his wife, Farhana, were discovered dead in their Gurgaon apartment. Aslam sent an alarming email to his employer before the incident, indicating a distressing situation. Police suspect that Aslam may have killed his wife before taking his own life. Relatives claim that Aslam had been struggling with depression for about 18 months prior to the tragedy.

After drugging him following conflicts over parking and music volume, he committed murder by strangulation. The victim, Pawan Sharma, was reported missing by his family, prompting an investigation that led to the arrest of Lalit Kumar Sharma, alongside the recovery of the vehicle used in the crime.

author: NIKHIL SHARMA
description: A 34-year-old woman named Neetu was discovered murdered in her home in Daulah village. Her husband, Prashant, found her body in the bathroom with injuries and signs of struggle. Police are investigating all angles, including potential theft, while the motive remains unclear. Forensic teams have collected evidence, and CCTV footage is being examined. A murder case against unidentified persons will be registered based on family statements.
